cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: oc create configmap app-config --from-literal=LOG_LEVEL=info --from-literal=FEATURE_X=on; oc get configmap app-config -o jsonpath='{.data}{"\n"}'
oc create deployment settings --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi-minimal:latest -- sleep infinity; oc rollout status deployment/settings --timeout=180s
entries.stdout:
deployment.apps/settings created

deployment "settings" successfully rolled out
entries.combined:

entries.cmd: oc set env deployment/settings --from=configmap/app-config; oc rollout status deployment/settings --timeout=180s >/dev/null; oc exec deploy/settings -- printenv LOG_LEVEL FEATURE_X

oc set volume deployment/settings --add --type=configmap --configmap-name=app-config --mount-path=/etc/app; oc rollout status deployment/settings --timeout=180s >/dev/null; oc exec deploy/settings -- ls /etc/app

entries.cmd: oc set data configmap/app-config LOG_LEVEL=debug; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(oc exec deploy/settings -- cat /etc/app/LOG_LEVEL)" = debug ] && break; sleep 5; done; echo "file changed at poll $i (polls are 5 seconds apart)"; echo "file: $(oc exec deploy/settings -- cat /etc/app/LOG_LEVEL)"; echo "variable: $(oc exec deploy/settings -- printenv LOG_LEVEL)"
